run_bm_diff_cli: run bm_diff.py with --old and --new benchmark names to compute performance differences between two benchmark runs
run_bm_diff_with_regex: run bm_diff.py with --regex flag to filter which benchmarks are compared between old and new runs
run_bm_diff_with_track: run bm_diff.py with --track flag to specify which metrics to track when comparing benchmark results
review_Benchmark_class: review the Benchmark class that stores samples and processes performance data to find significant differences
review_diff_function: review the diff function that reads JSON benchmark files and outputs a tabulated table of significant results
